title: The Secret of the Old Book

sentences.text: Maya, Leo, and Sam were good friends.
Last Saturday, they went to the town library.
It was a rainy day, and the library was very quiet.
Maya loved old books.
She found a very big, dark blue book on a high shelf.
She opened it carefully.
A small piece of paper fell out.
It was a note.
The note had a riddle.
It said: “I have a face and two hands, but I have no arms.
I am in the center of town.”
Leo thought for a minute.
“A clock!” he said.
“The big clock in the town square!”
The friends were excited.
They left the library.
A man in a long, dark coat was near the door.
He watched them, but he did not speak.
The friends felt a little scared.
They ran to the town square.
The big clock was tall.
Sam looked around the bottom of the clock.
“Here!” he said.
“There is another note behind a loose stone.”
This note said: “I am the oldest resident in the park.
I have many rings but no fingers.”
Maya knew the answer.
“It’s the big oak tree!” she shouted.
They ran to the park.
The old oak tree was huge.
The man in the dark coat was walking fast behind them.
They must be quick!
Leo saw a small hole in the tree.
Inside, there was a little wooden box.
They opened the box.
Just then, the man arrived.
He was not scary.
He was Mr. Gable, the old librarian!
He was smiling.
“Good job!” Mr. Gable said.
“This is a history hunt.
I made it for you.”
The box was full of old photos of their town.
The friends were not scared anymore.
They were very happy because they had a fun adventure.
